name: tradeconnect
description: AI-powered export execution infrastructure for Indonesian SMEs — hybrid microservice monorepo

scripts.docker:up: docker compose --profile full --profile workers --profile obs up -d --build --force-recreate
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose --profile full --profile workers --profile obs up -d --build --force-recreate
scripts.docker:reset:infra: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres redis
scripts.py:sync: pnpm -F never run nothing || (cd services/matching-service && uv sync) && (cd ../comms-service && uv sync) && (cd ../etl-worker && uv sync)
